pages.text: Beyond the twin gatehouse lies a maze of courtyards, rooms and covered passages. The keep and side wings have three storeys above a lower vault. Stairs and bridges form winding loops between floors. Use banners and furnishings to recognize places you have passed.

Shield-bearing royal remnants defend rooms. A gallery commander alerts nearby allies; the deep elite calls one reinforcement after losing half its health. They stay near their assigned post. Defeat each chamber’s watch, then use its golden-topped relay.

The courtyard relay records seal A. The gallery relay records seal B and grants a Royal Survey Compass. Use the compass nearby for a horizontal bearing inward. Lost or stored seals do not erase chamber memories. Peaceful allows noncombat relay progression. Keep inventory slots free for rewards. If saving fails, resolve the storage problem and retry at the same relay.

Both memories and the deep watch unlock one shared Royal Synthesis Core for this sanctum. Other players can seek another sanctum for another core. Breaking or replacing a relay cannot reset it. The ruins remain available to dismantle or remodel. $(l:world/royal_synthesis)Make a new synthesis station$() after returning.
